options.content:
# 1. Variables

The following variables apply to all charts except Distributed Tracing:
- server: Server-side service
- endpoint: Endpoint (HTTP/RPC protocols support endpoint extraction, other protocols show empty)
- l7_protocol: Application protocol (HTTP/DNS/MySQL, etc.)
- signal_source: Signal source, currently supports three signal sources: Packet (cBPF), eBPF, OTel
  - eBPF: Function call data collected using eBPF. The dashboard defaults to eBPF signal source ([kernel version requirements](https://deepflow.io/docs/ce-install/overview/)). If no data, switch to Packet.
  - Packet: Network traffic data collected using AF_PACKET + cBPF
  - OTel: Distributed tracing data received via OTEL protocol
- vm: VM / Cloud Host filter

All charts are built on DeepFlow data.

# 2. Endpoint List

The endpoint list shows Request Rate, Error Ratio, and Response Latency for each Server Service + Endpoint + Protocol combination.
- Click column headers to sort and quickly find endpoints with high error rates or latency
- Click a row to open endpoint details

For detailed metric descriptions, see [DeepFlow Metrics Documentation](https://deepflow.io/docs/features/universal-map/metrics-and-operators/).

# 3. Endpoint Details

Shows endpoint details via metric line charts, call log tables, and distributed tracing flame graphs.

## 3.1. Metric Charts

- **Request Rate**: Request rate trend for the selected server + endpoint + protocol
- **Response Latency**: P90 and P99 response latency trends
- **Error Ratio**: Client and server error ratio trends
- **Timeout Count**: Timeout trend

## 3.2. Call Log

Detailed call log for the selected endpoint, showing client service, response codes, error descriptions, etc.

## 3.3. Distributed Tracing

Distributed tracing displayed as a flame graph. See [DeepFlow Tracing Documentation](https://deepflow.io/docs/guide/ee-tenant/dashboard/panel/flame/).
